rules.rationale: Evidence, explanation, qualification and synthesis can justify content.
Claims require supplied evidence and accurate scope.
Missing argument must identify absent reasoning; empty pixels alone are advisory.
Measured fit and readable type are required.
Every ranked criterion needs one comparative exhibit across all options.
rules.positive: Scorecard covering all options on every ranked criterion
rules.negative: Recommendation resting on an unmeasured tie-breaker

rules.rationale: Titles carry the answer: within 14 words, hedge-free, distinct from each other.
rules.positive: Transit rides use only 15-28 of the 45 minutes
rules.negative: The 45-minute limit looks plausible for some journeys

rules.rationale: Interpretation adds reasoning missing from the title and exhibit; a separate closing strip is optional.
rules.positive: A complete comparison without a footer conclusion, or two distinct supported insights beside their evidence
rules.negative: Callout and closing strip repeat the same proposition

rules.rationale: Every plotted coordinate encodes a sourced measure, calculation or named category position.
rules.negative: Jittered offsets inside a category band

rules.rationale: A chart heading names measure, population and period; statistics live on the marks.
Complete current coverage; delivery requires passing gates and an accepted review.
Annotate when it clarifies the relationship.
